name: Brush API
description: Brush API: the game-capability APIs (content registration / networking / creative tabs / HUD and input / screen events / keybinds) extracted from the loader core so the core keeps only loader duties. Phase C: networking's two injection points and keybinds moved here. 2026-10-15 (docs/26 section 7.7): the NETWORK ENGINE itself (BrushNetwork / BrushChannels / BrushPayload / ReplyGuard / DispatchDedupe) and the S3 payload bridge moved here too, keeping their original package names; the core only hands the host event bus over through host.HostSeams. Mods that use networking must compile against this mod (or the contract jar, which now includes these api classes).
